attacks.detail: item from the 100-batch verified against the 200-batch root = False. Different root -> rejected; a proof is bound to its own batch.

attacks.attack: 2. Index manipulation (claim a different leaf index)
attacks.detail: item 20's commitment+proof claimed at index 21 -> verifies=False (the audit path reconstructs a different root).
dropping one item -> root sha256:0bfd66092…; adding one -> sha256:342279c3d…; both differ from the pinned full root sha256:9057075cf… -> detectable.

attacks.attack: 4. Leaf/node confusion (node hash as a leaf)
attacks.detail: presenting an internal node hash as a leaf commitment -> verifies=False. RFC 6962 prefixes leaves (0x00) and nodes (0x01) differently, so a node can't masquerade as a leaf (second-preimage resistance).
